parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Define electric field at a point.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
An isolated conducting sphere in a vacuum has a capacitance of 69 pF.
The charge on the sphere is +83 pC.
parts.text:
On Fig. 6.1, draw field lines to represent the electric field outside the sphere due to the charge on the sphere.

[[fig:f1]]

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the electric potential at the surface of the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the radius of the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Calculate the electric field strength *E* at the surface of the sphere. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The sphere in (b) is discharged by connecting it to earth (0 V) through a resistor of resistance 120 MΩ.

Calculate the time taken for the charge to fall to 26 pC.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.1
figures.alt: A blank circle representing the conducting sphere.
